meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面；Codex CLI 优先使用内置 ImageGen，无需单独 API Key。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入书名和作者，自动生成专业网文封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为网文生成专业封面而不懂设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate a novel cover with title and author from book info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a polished cover for your web novel

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按书名、作者名和目标平台判断题材，生成带书名与笔名文字的网文封面图，存到指定输出目录，并先给 2-3 个构图方案供你挑。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-cover 或 /封面，或说「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」等话时触发；书名或笔名缺失时它会先问你补全。

say.text: 帮我做个封面，书名《XX》，笔名XX，发番茄小说
say.note: 会先确认平台和输出目录再出图

say.text: 用这张参考图生成封面，风格跟着参考图
say.note: 切到图生图，并保存参考图副本

say.text: 换个构图再出一版封面
say.note: 新版本号保存，不覆盖旧图

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the book title, author name and target platform to pick a genre, generates a web-novel cover image with the title and pen name drawn on it, saves it to your output folder, and first offers 2-3 layout options.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you enter /story-cover or /封面, or ask it to make a novel cover; if the title or pen name is missing, it asks you to fill them in first.

say_en.text: Make a cover for my novel, title XX, pen name XX, for Tomato Novel
say_en.note: Confirms platform and output folder first

say_en.text: Generate a cover using this reference image
say_en.note: Switches to image-to-image and saves the reference

say_en.text: Try another layout for the cover
say_en.note: Saves a new version, keeps old files
